message.content:
The value of $20 in British pounds depends on the current exchange rate, which fluctuates throughout the day. As a rough estimate—using a recent average rate of about 1 USD ≈ 0.78 GBP—the conversion would be:

\[
\$20 \times 0.78 \approx £15.60
\]

So, roughly **£15–16**. For an exact amount at the time of your transaction, you’d need to check a live currency converter or your bank’s rate.
